passages.text: Our science club watches a short film about a satellite launch. In the film, the satellite will get into orbit around Earth. A moving line on the screen shows its path around the planet. After the film, we build a small paper model together. I take photos of the model for our class display. Lily writes short notes to explain each part beside my pictures. We put the pictures and notes together so visitors can follow our work.

parallelText.en: A moving line on the screen shows its path around the planet.
parallelText.zh: 屏幕上一条移动的线显示它绕地球运行的路径。

parallelText.en: After the film, we build a small paper model together.

passages.text: Nora reads a story about a woman living on a space station. The woman works with two friends in a building high above Earth. Each morning, she does exercise before starting her day's work. In one picture, she moves her legs on a special bicycle. Nora draws the woman and writes about this part of her day. Her teacher asks the class to compare the story with their own routines. Nora says she also enjoys moving her body before a busy school day.

parallelText.en: Nora reads a story about a woman living on a space station.
parallelText.zh: 诺拉读了一个关于一位住在空间站上的女性的故事。

parallelText.en: The woman works with two friends in a building high above Earth.
parallelText.zh: 这位女性和两个朋友在地球上空的一座建筑里工作。

parallelText.en: Each morning, she does exercise before starting her day's work.
parallelText.zh: 每天早晨，她开始一天的工作前先锻炼身体。

parallelText.en: In one picture, she moves her legs on a special bicycle.
parallelText.zh: 一幅图中，她在一辆特殊自行车上活动双腿。

parallelText.en: Nora draws the woman and writes about this part of her day.
parallelText.zh: 诺拉画下这位女性，并写下她一天中的这部分生活。

parallelText.en: Her teacher asks the class to compare the story with their own routines.
parallelText.zh: 老师请全班把故事和自己的日常安排作比较。

parallelText.en: Nora says she also enjoys moving her body before a busy school day.
parallelText.zh: 诺拉说，在忙碌的上学日开始前，她也喜欢活动身体。
